spatialui.settings.title: Hoverglass Settings
spatialui.opacity.global.hint: Transparency used by every screen without its own saved value
spatialui.opacity.current.hint: Saved for this screen class. 0% is opaque; 100% is transparent. Items and text stay readable.
spatialui.opacity.dim.hint: Darkens the world behind open screens; 0% leaves it untouched
spatialui.settings.reset.hint: Restores every page and container override. Click twice; the rotating snapshots can bring a previous config back.
spatialui.settings.global.hint: Open a container to set its own transparency
spatialui.settings.hint: Scroll / PgUp/PgDn · Del ×2 resets page · Esc saves
spatialui.settings.reset_page.hint: Reset this page to defaults (Del twice)
spatialui.settings.reset_page.confirm.hi: Click again to reset this page to defaults, or press Delete again
spatialui.settings.reset_page.none: Compatibility settings are hand-written; edit the config file to reset them
spatialui.settings.save_failed: Hoverglass could not save settings. Changes remain active for this game session.
spatialui.scale.hint: Overall size of the spatial UI; 1.00 is the default
spatialui.camera.distance.hint: How far the camera pulls back to frame the panel
spatialui.camera.duration.hint: Length of the camera move when the inventory opens
spatialui.camera.hint: Pulls the camera back to frame the panel; off keeps the vanilla view
spatialui.camera.container.hint: When off, chests and other containers keep the first-person view; the inventory keeps its entrance camera.
spatialui.anchors.hint: Keeps the glass panel placed in the world so it holds still as the camera turns
spatialui.inventory.cinematic.hint: Slides the inventory in from the side; off opens it without the side entrance
spatialui.inventory.close.hint: Off closes the panel instantly instead of sliding it away
spatialui.inventory.tilt.hint: Tilt of the settled panel in degrees; negative leans the other way
spatialui.inventory.duration.hint: Length of the panel's opening slide
spatialui.inventory.glass.hint: Draws the inventory as a glass panel; off shows the vanilla inventory
spatialui.inventory.side.hint: How far the panel sits beside the avatar when settled
spatialui.inventory.reopen.hint: Reopening a container inside this window skips the entrance and camera animation. 0 disables the shortcut.
spatialui.inventory.preset.confirm: Click again to replace the glass look
spatialui.inventory.preset.hint: Sets the reference glass style across opacity, rim, camera and animation values; your own tuning on those pages is replaced
spatialui.container_scale.hint: Screen-space size of chests and other readable containers
spatialui.look.enabled.hint: Turns the avatar's head toward the slot under the cursor while the inventory is open
spatialui.look.head_yaw.hint: How far the avatar's head can turn left or right toward the cursor
spatialui.look.head_pitch.hint: How far the avatar's head can look up or down
spatialui.look.smoothing.hint: How quickly the head chases the cursor; higher is snappier
spatialui.layout.player_height.hint: Fraction of the window height the previewed avatar occupies
spatialui.layout.player_x.hint: 0% is the left edge, 100% the right edge
spatialui.layout.player_y.hint: 0% is the top edge, 100% the bottom edge
spatialui.layout.panel_x.hint: Moves the glass panel; 50% centers it
spatialui.layout.recipe_book.hint: Shifts the panel while the recipe book is open; 0 disables the shift
spatialui.layout.depth.hint: Distance in front of the camera for readable containers; lower values make them appear larger
spatialui.layout.vertical.hint: Moves the spatial panels up or down in the world
spatialui.feel.open_speed.hint: Pixels per second before the panel settles
spatialui.feel.slide_brake.hint: Deceleration during the slide-in; higher stops sooner (px/s²)
spatialui.feel.bounce.hint: How far the panel springs back after the slide; 0 is a clean stop
spatialui.feel.close_speed.hint: Pixels per second while the panel slides away
spatialui.feel.close_brake.hint: Deceleration while the panel slides away; higher values cut the exit short, lower values let it coast
spatialui.feel.spring.hint: Spring strength pulling the panel to rest; higher settles sooner
spatialui.feel.damping.hint: Resistance while settling; lower values wobble for longer
spatialui.support.handled.hint: Off leaves every built-in container on the vanilla screen
spatialui.support.fallback.hint: Off lets a screen the camera cannot reach fall back to vanilla
spatialui.support.optin: Treat this screen as a container
spatialui.support.optin.remove: Stop treating this screen as a container
spatialui.support.optin.rule: Already handled by a screen rule
spatialui.support.optin.hint: Applies the glass panel to the screen the settings were opened from
spatialui.support.key.hint: Cycles F6–F10; F8 is the default
spatialui.support.clear_optins.hint: Removes every screen added here, including wildcard rules
spatialui.enabled.hint: Turns off the glass panels, HUD glass, menu theme and added avatar animations without changing any other setting. The settings key still works.
spatialui.material.slot.hint: Fill behind every empty slot cell
spatialui.material.panel_rim.hint: Outline around the glass panel itself
spatialui.material.slot_rim.hint: Outline drawn around each slot cell
spatialui.material.hover.hint: Tint shown under the cursor while it is over a slot
spatialui.material.selected.hint: Tint on the slot matching the held hotbar item
spatialui.material.preset.clear.hint: Barely-there fills with thin rims, best on dark scenes
spatialui.material.preset.frosted.hint: The reference look shipped with the default config
spatialui.material.preset.vivid.hint: Heavier fills and rims for bright or busy backgrounds
spatialui.camera.yaw_offset.hint: Sideways angle around the panel, from -60 to 60 degrees
spatialui.camera.pitch_offset.hint: Up or down angle around the panel, from -45 to 45 degrees
spatialui.camera.preset.subtle.hint: Closer, flatter framing with a quick transition
spatialui.camera.preset.cinematic.hint: A wider pull-back with a slower sweep
spatialui.camera.level.hint: Zeroes both angle offsets and leaves distance, side and tilt as they are
spatialui.camera.third_person.hint: Pulls the camera back to show the avatar when the inventory opens; off keeps the first-person view and only the glass panel appears
spatialui.compat.exclude.hint: Leaving the glass panel off for this screen type keeps every menu and slot vanilla. An exclusion written by a wildcard rule is shown here but must be removed in the config file or with the clear button.
spatialui.transfer.paste.hint: Replaces every setting with the clipboard contents; click twice
spatialui.transfer.copied: Hoverglass settings copied to the clipboard.
spatialui.transfer.invalid: The clipboard does not contain Hoverglass settings.
spatialui.transfer.restore.hint: Replaces every setting with the file written by the last save; click twice
spatialui.transfer.no_backup: No previous Hoverglass settings are available yet.
spatialui.transfer.snapshot.hint: Each save keeps the previous file in a small rotating history; the arrows pick one, newest first
spatialui.transfer.snapshot.none: Hoverglass has no saved snapshot yet.
spatialui.transfer.snapshot.restored: The newest Hoverglass snapshot was restored.
spatialui.motion.player.hint: Master switch for the added third-person body animations
spatialui.motion.player_attack.hint: Adds full-body swings to the avatar's use animation
spatialui.motion.crafting.hint: Adds a crafting motion at a workbench; local player only
spatialui.motion.sprint_stride.hint: Adds leg and arm pumping to the avatar's sprint
spatialui.motion.airborne.hint: Adds jump and fall poses to the avatar
spatialui.motion.idle.hint: Adds a subtle sway to the avatar when standing still
spatialui.motion.player_intensity.hint: Strength of the added third-person swings, strides and poses
spatialui.motion.enabled.hint: Master switch for the added animations and feedback; off leaves vanilla behaviour
spatialui.motion.reduce.hint: Suppresses the added effects while keeping their settings, for motion-sensitive players
spatialui.motion.swap.hint: Animates the held item as it changes instead of switching instantly
spatialui.motion.attack.hint: Adds follow-through to sword and tool swings
spatialui.motion.hand_intensity.hint: Strength of the first-person hand and item motion
spatialui.motion.sprint.hint: Adds a sway to the camera and held item while sprinting
spatialui.motion.jump.hint: Nudges the view upward when jumping
spatialui.motion.hit.hint: Adds a tiny shake when a hit is confirmed
spatialui.motion.camera_intensity.hint: Strength of the camera sway during sprinting, jumps and landings
spatialui.motion.break.hint: Adds extra material fragments when a block breaks
spatialui.motion.place.hint: Adds a brief particle pulse when a block is placed
spatialui.motion.particle_multiplier.hin: Multiplies the particles spawned when blocks break or place
spatialui.hotbar.glass.hint: Draws the hotbar as a glass strip with slot cells
spatialui.hotbar.transparency.hint: Fill opacity of the glass hotbar
spatialui.hotbar.border.hint: Outline strength around the hotbar slots
spatialui.hotbar.match_rim.hint: Copies the glass panel's rim strength onto the hotbar
spatialui.hotbar.match_rim.done: The hotbar rim already matches the panel
spatialui.hotbar.glass_off: Turn on the glass hotbar to tune or match it
spatialui.hotbar.match_opacity.hint: Copies the glass panel's fill opacity onto the hotbar
spatialui.hotbar.match_opacity.done: The hotbar fill already matches the panel
spatialui.ui.liquid_glass.hint: Rounded glass and hover highlights for standard buttons and sliders in pause, options and settings menus. Applies instantly, independently of glass inventory.
